passing_score.verbatim: Pass the written knowledge and road sign tests.

exam_facts.note: Handbook (physical p21, printed p7) requires a TIP applicant to pass a vision test and the written knowledge and road sign tests, and to arrive at least one hour before closing for an original operator's license knowledge test; it states no question count, no passing score or percent, and no time limit for the Secretary of State knowledge test (full-text searches for pass/percent/score/correct/questions found none). The 70 percent minimums on physical p18-19 apply to driver education Segment 1 and Segment 2 state exams, not the SOS knowledge test. The sample test on physical p83 (printed p69) is 10 practice questions, not the exam format. Nulls are genuine absences, not imported from memory.
